links.outcome: Chatbot response quality on visual monitor images versus contextual case information
links.effect: Contextual scenario scores were higher than visual ones across all platforms. ChatGPT contextual 4.6 ± 0.3 vs visual 4.1 ± 0.9; DeepSeek often misinterpreted monitor values, lowest score 2.7 ± 1.1.
links.quote: Overall, contextual scenarios scores were higher than visual ones across all platforms.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating multiple commercial multimodal LLM chatbots on simulated intraoperative anesthetic crisis scenarios with static monitor images. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
